column3: Close to the Hebrew; “he made their rains hail” is rendered “He gave them hail for rain.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second word for locust is rendered “young locusts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the beginning of all their manly vigor” is rendered “The first fruits of all their vigor.”
The Hebrew has the singular “he asked”; NASB reads the plural “They asked.”
NASB adds “like” (“like a river”); the Hebrew says “they went in the dry regions [as] a river.”
NASB adds “the fruit of” and makes the second line a purpose clause (“That they might take possession of”).
